As Director of Product Management, you will own Streams end to end and lead the PM team behind it. Your job is to make Elastic the easiest platform to bring data to, for every solution and every customer.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values-Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable-and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca ’s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.
Things You Get To Do

• Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.

• Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.

• Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.

• Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.

• Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.

• Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.

• Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.

• Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.

• Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

• You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.

• You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.

• You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don’t).

title: Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting (Any city, IL
description:
It takes great medical minds to create powerful solutions that solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges. Join us and put your expertise to work in ways you never imagined possible. We know you’ve honed your career in a fast-moving medical environment. While Gainwell operates with a sense of urgency, you’ll have the opportunity to work more flexible hours. And working at Gainwell carries its rewards. You’ll have an incredible opportunity to grow your career in a company that values work-life balance, continuous learning, and career development.

Summary

As a Principal Medicaid Pharmacy Strategist, PDL, Pricing & Contracting at Gainwell, you will contribute your pharmacy, Medicaid, analytical, and clinical expertise to support state Medicaid pharmacy programs and the populations they serve. This role supports the development and maintenance of Medicaid Preferred Drug Lists (PDLs), clinical coverage criteria, drug cost analyses, and supplemental rebate strategies.

The ideal candidate will be a pharmacist with extensive knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy operations, including drug pricing methodologies, supplemental rebate programs, Medicaid Drug Rebate Program concepts, clinical criteria development, and pharmacy point-of-sale (POS) claims processing. This position requires a strong ability to translate complex clinical, utilization, pricing, and rebate data into actionable recommendations for Medicaid clients.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to independently analyze large and complex pharmacy datasets are essential to success in this role.

Your role in our mission

• Support Medicaid Preferred Drug List (PDL) strategy through analysis of drug products, clinical criteria, utilization, pricing, and rebate opportunities.

• Conduct financial analyses using drug pricing, utilization, and Medicaid rebate data to support formulary and coverage recommendations.

• Evaluate clinical criteria, prior authorizations, and pharmacy benefit requirements to optimize access, cost, and rebate outcomes.

• Analyze utilization, expenditures, pricing trends, and supplemental rebate offers to develop client recommendations.

• Build reports, forecasts, and analytical models using advanced Excel and large datasets.

• Present findings to clients and committees, translating complex clinical and financial data into actionable recommendations.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement PDL, rebate, and pharmacy program strategies.

• Monitor market developments, validate program data, and maintain accurate analytical documentation.

What we're looking for

• Licensed Pharmacist (RPh or PharmD) in the U.S.

• 5+ years of pharmacy experience, including Medicaid pharmacy, managed care, PBM operations, formulary management, or related areas.

• Strong knowledge of Medicaid pharmacy programs, including PDLs, utilization management, prior authorization, claims adjudication, and pharmacy benefit operations.

• Experience with drug pricing, Medicaid rebates, supplemental rebates, pharmaceutical contracting, and financial analysis.

• Experience developing or evaluating formularies, PDLs, prior authorization, and utilization management criteria.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including analysis of large datasets and financial modeling.

• Ability to translate clinical, pricing, utilization, and rebate data into sound pharmacy benefit recommendations.

• Preferred: Experience supporting state Medicaid PDL programs, Medicaid supplemental rebate programs, rebate pools, or multi-state contracting initiatives.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience identifying and reconciling data discrepancies across multiple sources.

What you should expect in this role

• 100% Remote (U.S. only)

• Travel: Up to 10%

Applications will be accepted through November 13, 2026.

The pay range for this position is $113,700.00 - $162,400.00 per year, however, the base pay offered may vary depending on geographic region,

- Lead a team of talented and high-performing engineers in the design, development, and support of highly distributed and scalable data platforms, with a specific focus on optimizing and enabling workloads on top of open table and open catalog formats like Apache Iceberg and Apache Polaris (incubating).

- Have direct impact on growth and development of your team through the full lifecycle of recruiting, hiring, mentorship, coaching, and identifying growth opportunities

- Demonstrate strong communication skills and the ability to work seamlessly across teams and organizations. Partner well with other leaders in the Engineering and Product organization on rhythms like annual & quarterly planning, staffing, project schedules, resource allocation, and more

- Be comfortable and effective in delegation - effectively leveraging Senior & Principal engineers to maximize your team’s impact

- Know when and how to shift resources across areas to achieve execution goals, while also ensuring effective ownership and longer-term alignment of work and skills

- Translate product requirements into engineering work for your team, partnering closely with peers in Product and other disciplines - to make our vision a reality!

Be the face of Conveo's Insight function in the US: the research expert our biggest clients call first, and the commercial partner who helps us win our largest deals.

ABOUT CONVEO

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high quality consumer / B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing, product, and research teams.

THE CONTEXT

AI moderation is changing what research can do. Qual depth at quant scale, in days rather than months. Our US client base is growing fast, and the question our biggest clients now ask is no longer "does AI moderation work?" but "what can we do now that was never possible before?" Answering that question, rigorously and commercially, is how we win and grow our most important accounts.

That is why we're hiring a Principal Research Strategist for the US. You'll be the face of Conveo's Insight function in the market. Every major US client will know you. You'll touch all of them, their biggest projects, and their biggest initiatives. You'll work side by side with Sales on our largest deals, with Marketing to build our brand, with Product to invent new methodologies, and with our Research Impact team to crack the hardest client problems.

You’ll spend roughly 70% of your time winning and designing big client programmes with Sales, and ~30% on product, marketing and researcher support.

This is a role with a real say in the strategy of the whole business. It is not for someone looking for a 9-to-5. It's for someone who wants more impact than they've had at any company before.

YOUR MISSION

1. DESIGN RESEARCH THAT SETS THE STANDARD FOR AI MODERATION

You are the methodological authority. When a client has a hard research problem, you design the answer, and it is both innovative and rigorous.

- Design methodologies for our clients' most important programs, especially ongoing listening programs and trackers

- Solve clients' most difficult research challenges within the context of Conveo's AI moderation platform

2. BECOME THE TRUSTED INSIGHT PARTNER TO OUR BIGGEST CLIENTS, AND HELP CLOSE OUR BIGGEST DEALS

- Own senior relationships with insight leaders and executives at our largest US accounts, up to C-suite

- Be involved in every major client's biggest projects and initiatives

- Partner with Sales on our largest deals: discovery, solution design, pitching, and closing

- Shape proposals that turn a first study into a multi-year, multi-team program

- Spot expansion opportunities early and bring them to the commercial team

3. BUILD CONVEO'S BRAND AS THE MOST TRUSTED VOICE IN AI MODERATION

With Marketing, you make Conveo the name the US insights industry trusts when it comes to AI moderation.

- Represent Conveo on stage at major industry conferences and events

- Lead thought leadership: talks, webinars, articles, and points of view on the future of research

- Publish research-on-research that proves the quality and validity of AI moderation

- Build a personal profile in the US insights community that elevates Conveo with it

4. INVENT WHAT'S NEXT WITH PRODUCT AND RESEARCH IMPACT

You bring a creative, builder mindset to what research can become, and you raise the bar across the team.

title: Google Ads Strategist
description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
That is the whole job.
Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.
So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.
At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.
You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.
Here is what "end to end" actually means.
You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.
You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.
You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.
You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.
If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.
If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.
Requirements
What the job looks like

•
Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.

•
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.

•
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.

•
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.

•
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.

•
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.

• Join a pre-IPO startup with capital, traction, and runway ($240M funded | 40X revenue growth in 4 years | $2T market size).

• Work closely with brilliant leaders and teammates from companies like McKinsey, BCG, Nvidia, Better, NerdWallet, SoFi, etc.

• Disrupt a massive market and help scale us to a $5B business in the next few years.

• Be immersed in a talent-dense environment and accelerate your career growth exponentially.

• Own Jerry ’s acquisition messaging end to end across a growing product lineup, from car insurance to home, renters, motorcycle, and RV & boat insurance, plus property tax appeals.

About the Role
At Jerry , we are redefining and radically improving how people manage car ownership, one of their most expensive and time-consuming assets. Backed by artificial intelligence and machine learning, Jerry simplifies and automates car ownership while providing personalized services tailored to all car owners’ needs. We are the #1 rated and most downloaded app in our category with a 4.7-star rating in the App Store and more than 5 million customers - and we’re just getting started. Now we’re expanding beyond the car to help people protect and save on their broader physical assets, with motorcycle, home, renters, and RV & boat insurance, and property tax appeals.
We’re looking for a Conversion Copywriter with direct-response instincts and a testing mindset. You’re someone who knows that one headline can move CPA more than a budget change. You’ll own the words across our acquisition funnel (search ads, paid social copy, and landing pages), and define how each new product shows up for customers from day one. You’ll write, test, and iterate on them at high speed, using AI to multiply your output without lowering the bar. You’ll report to our Creative Lead and work day to day with our SEM, paid social, and growth teams
Why you will (or won’t) like working here:

• Your work is measured. Every line you write is tested against CTR, CVR, and CPA. If you love seeing the impact of your words in the data, you’ll thrive. If you’d rather write one perfect manifesto, this isn’t the role.

• Build from zero: We’re launching several new products, and each one needs its story written for the first time. You’ll create the foundational value props: positioning, proof points, and the first messages tested in market. You’ll be building those, not just tweaking copy that already works.

• End-to-end ownership: You’ll build the messaging foundation (angles, proof points, an approved-claims library) that the all marketing channels, website, app store all draw from. You’ll also write the RSAs yourself.

• Insurance is not “sexy,” and it’s regulated: People think about insurance when a renewal bill arrives, and nobody wakes up excited about a property tax appeal. Can you make savings feel real and trustworthy, and stay compliant while doing it?

What You’ll Do

• Write and iterate acquisition copy across channels: Google RSAs, Meta and TikTok primary text and headlines, YouTube and CTV supers, and landing pages.

• Build foundational value propositions for new products: For each new product (motorcycle, home, renters, RV & boat insurance, property tax appeal), research the customer, the competitors, and what makes Jerry different. Then define the core UVP, the messaging hierarchy, and the proof points, and validate them quickly through paid tests.

• Own the testing roadmap for copy: form hypotheses, structure tests so they produce clear learnings, read the results, and ship the next round quickly.

• Develop angles, hooks, and messaging frameworks grounded in customer insight. You’ll dig through app reviews, support tickets, call transcripts, and Reddit for the language customers actually use.

• Make landing pages convert: keep the message consistent from ad to page, structure the page as an argument, handle objections, and add trust signals. You’ll partner with marketers and growth PMs on CRO.

description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the role

REGEX (Registration Experience) owns the longest and most conversion-intensive stage of Nubank Mexico’s onboarding funnel: the ~30-screen Registration flow covering identity verification, CURP, biometrics, address, consents and contracts. This is the stage that turns a qualified prospect into a Nu customer, so every improvement moves our Onboarding Rate and customer releases.

As a Senior Product Manager in Nubank Mexico’s Growth organization, you will co-own the strategy, roadmap and results of this flow, with Onboarding Rate and Registration conversion as your core metrics. You’ll work day to day in a multi-disciplinary squad (Senior PM, Tech Manager, engineers, Business Analyst, Design and 2nd line of Defense: Legal, Risk, Compliance) and report into Growth Mexico product leadership.

You’ll be responsible for

- Co-owning the vision, strategy and roadmap of the Registration flow, with Onboarding Rate and Registration conversion as your core metrics.

- Finding friction across the ~30 screens through funnel data, experiments and customer research, then prioritizing and shipping fixes and personalization.

- Running A/B tests end to end: hypothesis, design, rollout and read-out.

- Leading the squad’s planning, rituals and delivery, and acting as squad lead when needed.

- Partnering with Risk, Compliance, Legal and Operations so changes meet regulatory requirements (for example, CNBV rules) without hurting conversion.

- Aligning with adjacent squads and stakeholders on scope, handovers and dependencies.

- Communicating progress, risks and learnings to leadership in weekly updates.

We are looking for a person who has

Required

- 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in fintech, banking or consumer digital products, owning a high-traffic funnel and its conversion outcomes.

- Hands-on experience with SQL and product analytics, turning data into prioritized decisions.

- Experience designing and reading experiments (A/B tests) and tying results to conversion outcomes.

- Experience leading through influence, aligning engineering, design, risk and business partners without formal authority.

- Balancing conversion, risk and regulatory constraints with strong customer judgment.

- Clear written and verbal communication in Spanish and English.

Nice to have

- Experience in onboarding, KYC or identity verification (biometrics, document validation).

- Familiarity with Mexican financial regulation and the Mexican market.

- Background in personalization or lifecycle messaging.

- Experience leading a squad and working closely with Technical/Engineering teams.

Location for this opportunity
Mexico City, Mexico

Our Benefits

- Chance of earning equity at Nu

- Extended maternity and paternity leaves

- Health and life insurance

- Dental and Vision Insurance

- NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

- Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

- NuLanguage - Our language learning program

title: Principal Product Manager, Chemical Simulation
description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

SandboxAQ’s AI Simulation (AISim) division develops and applies Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) that are grounded in physics, chemistry, mathematics and biology to simulate molecular behavior with scientific precision and accelerate discovery in the physical world across biopharma, chemicals, advanced materials, healthcare, and so much more.

Within AISim, ChemSim is SandboxAQ's AI-driven materials discovery platform. We are seeking an exceptional Product Manager to advance our AI/ML products. This is a dual-mandate role. In the near term, you will be the product owner for one of our ChemSim verticals within SandboxAQ's $500M CHIPS Act R&D award from the U.S. Department of Commerce, translating contractual objectives into product requirements and external fulfilment, whilst partnering with Program Managers to ensure successful milestone delivery. In parallel, you will build the commercial foundation that turns our ChemSim work from government-funded R&D workstreams into a product-led business generating durable, recurring revenue from the broader materials and process-chemistry market.

Materials science and industrial chemistry are among the largest and most consequential application areas in applied science. ChemSim spans catalysis, batteries, magnets and alloys, and PFAS replacements: four verticals that underpin refining and downstream oil and gas, commodity and petrochemical production, emissions control, and the energy transition, alongside semiconductor substrates and process chemistry, energy storage, and fine chemical synthesis. Across nearly all of these markets the bottleneck is the same: materials discovery and optimization remain slow, experimental and expensive, and the simulation tools available today answer narrower questions than the ones that actually decide a product or process. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to shape a category-defining AI platform for materials science

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the end-to-end product strategy for a ChemSim product inlcuding vision and roadmap, spanning CHIPS Act contractual deliverables, vertical scientific depth, and commercial expansion into new markets.

- Build a deep understanding of customer needs by working closely with Application Scientists and the Business Development team. Synthesize field insights, application benchmarking data, and market feedback into a clear picture of customer personas, and performance drivers, and translate these into prioritized product requirements and specifications.

- Translate the program's objectives into clear product requirements, a vertical roadmap, and the evidence packages required for Fulfillment Notices to the U.S. Department of Commerce.

- Define the dataset and model requirements for the vertical, chemical coverage, fidelity, and the benchmarking that determines where simulation investment is directed in partnership with our scientific and ML teams.

- Drive the roadmap from property and energetic

• •Define and execute route-to-market strategies for Gas, Water Tubing, and Electrical segments, including channel design, direct-versus-distributor decisions, pricing architecture, and territory coverage models.

title: Engagement Manager - EMEA
description:
ClickHouse is the open-source, real-time analytical database behind a lot of today's AI. More than 5,000 companies build on ClickHouse, including Anthropic, OpenAI, Tesla and Meta.

As an Engagement Manager on our team, you run the operational side of our consulting projects. You make sure the right people are on the right work at the right time, that every project is scoped, scheduled, tracked and billed properly, and that customers, partners and our own engineers always know where things stand.

Our Support Services team has always worked hands-on with customers. As more large enterprises move onto ClickHouse, that work is becoming a formal professional services practice, with scoped projects, partners delivering alongside us and hundreds of projects in flight each year. You'll be one of our first Engagement Managers, so you'll help build how this works.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Perform as an Engagement Manager in your region to manage operations and oversee delivery and reporting of consulting projects

- Staff each project with Consulting Engineers, TAM Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineers, and partner consultants, working closely with Consulting Leadership

- Collaborate with Customers, Technical Support, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure user and customer success with ClickHouse Cloud and products

- Work with Sales, Finance, partners, and subcontractors on statements of work, agreements, quotes, order forms, and billing with a high degree of organization and accuracy

- Develop a broad understanding of ClickHouse use cases and technology in order to identify and communicate planning and value in customer and partner meetings

- Keep a clear plan and schedule for every project, and flag risks to scope, timeline, or budget including tracking time, utilisation, and progress

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years in professional services engagement or management, consulting, or program or project delivery, ideally at a Cloud or software company

- Experience staffing and scheduling technical consultants across many projects at once

- A good grasp of the commercial side of services: statements of work, time and materials, order forms, and billing

- Experience working with partners and subcontractors on customer projects

- You're highly organised and keep lots of moving parts visible to everyone involved

- You're confident with engineers and customers, and curious about the technology to understand the work you're staffing

- Fluent English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with professional services automation (PSA) tools

- Salesforce experience

- A background at a database, data, or cloud company

GOOD TO KNOW

- Remote (Amsterdam, Netherlands or London, UK)

- This role isn't billed to customers. Your job is to make delivery run smoothly, not to deliver the work yourself

- Travel is occasional, for specific projects or internal events

- You'll work closely with our Consulting Management, TAM Architects, and Consulting Engineers, and with many other ClickHouse teams

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

CULTURE - WE ALL SHAPE IT

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here https://clickhouse.com/company/careers. Check out our blog posts https://clickhouse.com/blog or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/clickhouseinc/li

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer, FedRAMP
description:
SentiLink https://www.sentilink.com/ helps institutions and protects customers by accurately resolving identities and flagging fraud risk. Each day, we verify more than 3 million identities, flagging 150k+ fraud attempts in the process. The problems we work on are challenging, and solving them takes deep domain expertise, rigorous analysis, and a willingness to dig into the details.

At SentiLink, you'll work alongside smart, highly collaborative colleagues who respect each other's time and judgment, take ownership, and follow through on their commitments. Together, we do truly meaningful work protecting the identities of innocent consumers and flagging the fraudsters attempting to exploit them.

We're well capitalized and growing quickly. We already serve 13 of the top 15 U.S. banks, we're expanding into new markets, and we're backed by Craft Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, NYCA, and Max Levchin. We've been named to the Forbes Fintech 50 https://www.forbes.com/companies/sentilink/?list=fintech50 and as a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260330439998/en/SentiLink-Named-a-2026-FICO-Industry-Vanguard-Decision-Award-Winner-for-Leadership-in-Identity-Theft-Detection. We were also the first company to go live https://resources.sentilink.com/blog/sentilink-makes-history-as-first-ecbsv-provider with the electronic Consent Based Social Security Number Verification (eCBSV) service, and we've testified before the U.S. Congress https://resources.sentilink.com/media/dr.-david-maimons-congressional-testimony-on-emerging-fraud-threats-and-the-evolving-fraud-landscape on the future of identity.

We want SentiLink to be the best place you've ever worked. We offer generous benefits and support a range of working arrangements, from fully remote to in-office. We are a digital-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India, and we meet in person regularly to build relationships. We have offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle (Bellevue), Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India.

ROLE:

SentiLink's Information Security team protects our systems, data, and customers while enabling the business to move quickly and securely. We operate a modern, AWS-based environment and support security and compliance programs including FedRAMP, SOC 2, and PCI DSS.

We're looking for a Senior Cloud Security Engineer to own and improve the technical security implementation of SentiLink's AWS GovCloud environment. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building, maintaining, and operating security controls-not a compliance or audit-management position.

You'll work across AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, identity and access management, security tooling, vulnerability management, and monitoring. You will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security Engineering, IT, and our Security & Risk team to turn security and FedRAMP requirements into effective, maintainable implementations. You should be comfortable independently identifying gaps, designing pragmatic solutions, and following through on implementation and ongoing operation.

This is an individual contributor role with meaningful technical ownership and no people-management responsibilities.

This is a U.S.-based role. U.S. citizenship is required to meet applicable government customer and access requirements for the position. Candidates must also be able to satisfy applicable agency personnel-screening and system-access requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, implement, maintain, and operate security controls within SentiLink's AWS GovCloud environment, including controls supporting FedRAMP Moderate requirements and continuous monitoring.

- Engineer and improve cloud security across AWS accounts, IAM, networking, EKS/Kubernetes, Linux workloads, secrets management, logging, and encryption.

- Define and implement role-based access control and least-privilege access

• Work with MA Ops leads and pillar stakeholders to document current-state processes, identify gaps or inconsistencies, and support future state design.
• Ensure SOPs and work instructions are clear, practical, and operationally usable, translating complex processes into structured, easy to follow documentation.
• Support ongoing version control, governance, and continuous improvement of process documentation.
KPI, Data & Reporting Support
• Support the definition, harmonisation, and documentation of operational KPIs across Medical Affairs, ensuring consistency in definitions, calculation logic, and data sources.
• Assist with data collection, validation, and analysis to support regular and ad hoc MA Ops reporting for leadership and pillar teams.
• Support the maintenance and evolution of dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI, Excel, Smartsheet), working with MA data and analytics partners.
• Produce clear insights, summaries, and commentary to accompany reports, highlighting trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
Stakeholder & Ways of Working Support
• Act as an interface between MA Ops, data / analytics teams, and pillar stakeholders, translating operational requirements into structured process and reporting outputs.
• Support roll out and adoption of standardised processes and reporting through clear documentation, guidance materials, and light change management support.
• Contribute to wider MA Ops initiatives linked to operational excellence, Lean / process improvement, and data maturity.
